lines.text: David and the army commanders set apart some sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals.
Jeduthun had six sons and prophesied with the harp, giving thanks and praise to the LORD.
God gave Heman the king's seer fourteen sons and three daughters through his promises, to humble him.
The trained musicians and their relatives numbered 388, and they cast lots for their duties, young and old alike.
The lots fell to twenty-four groups, each made up of a man, his sons, and his brothers, 12 in all.
